scripts.lint: npm run lint:check -w apps/api && npm run lint:check -w apps/web && npm run format:check -w apps/web && npm run format:check -w e2e
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w apps/api && npm run typecheck -w apps/web && npm run typecheck -w e2e
scripts.test: npm test -w apps/api && npm test -w apps/web
scripts.test:tz: cross-env TZ=America/New_York npm test -w apps/api && cross-env TZ=America/New_York npm test -w apps/web
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.seed:demo: docker compose exec -T api node dist/seed-demo.js
